ctx.x: Then Pastotis' wife was -- Pastotis had an old car, I think it was an old Ford or something and Burns sent and got a Packard, beautiful Packard. This is around 1936 and the Packard was a beautiful thing. Then Burns took the Packard off the boat and Pastotis got that devil look in him and then the lady got that love look on her for Burns.

Now in the meantime, I'm hanging out with the Arabs, not Arabs, but Egyptians, then I became (inaudible) Egyptians. I was learning to speak, Mohammed passions; that was big and big and Chitte son was still running around, so one night Chitte son said come with me, I know a place where all the pretty women in the world are, and I said, well, Chitte son you didn't come down here with no women, I got mine over there. He said, man, will you please come with me. I'm going to a Greek carabet.
